question: NMGT is related to THKQ in a certain way. In the same way, LSQR is related to RNUO. To which of the given options is GIUH related, following the same logic?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d89b34e987ff4a912663872391582694c9265e17d4ff48a5281172ac96cf581f.png] Logic followed here is: The letters of the first word are shifted by a pattern of +6, -5, +4, and -3 respectively to obtain the letters of the second word. **For NMGT : THKQ →**
